alpha_rule: Half of the larger feasible signed naturalHF nullspace direction line bound. Original natural field unchanged; no HR clipping/rescale and no manual gain search. Zero bound is retained and reported.
sensor: FP64 full136field→128 crop atHRorigin4+(phase*2), reflectGaussian.6/5tap+TorchAA bicubic; quantizeduint8 withsigma.003. Primary natural photos unchanged.
VAL_scope: Only natural world is stored as eligibleVAL data. MechanicalVAL counterfactual metrics are separate here; no VAL auxiliary images or pair labels are stored for training.
future_distribution: All4future phases per physical world, including each TRAIN auxiliary world. Writer sees only past_lr_uint8 and no futurephase/operator, labels, sourceID or camera answer.
scope: Controlled natural-photo measurement/codec data, not real video, naturalH3 identity diversity, or learned H3 method efficacy.
